name: mario_walk_right
notes: Baseline: hold Right for 600 frames from cold boot. Mario Bros. (World) stays on its attract loop with Right held — no state transitions, so nes_core and nes-py render byte-exact. Warmup 10 skips the initial reset-to-stable-PPU window where both emulators transiently diverge. If this tape fails: palette LUT drifted, core mapper loading broke, or PPU fundamentals regressed. Catches the 2026-04-22 palette-class bugs.
